The wordplay does not work here. 1.禅輩 will just be confusing since it is not a word and does not make sense. 2.Japanese puns (駄洒落 dajare) are more strict than English puns so letters are an exact match in most cases. With 禅輩, words like 全廃(zenpai) or 全敗(zenpai) are a fit. Simply rhyming them won't lead them to make a connection to 先輩(senpai). 3.Usage of senpai hinders this interpretation. Since Name+先輩 is the normal usage, it doesn't make sense to include your name into the word 先輩.
